I saved Marcus's note in the brain: the signed order form for Thornbury Cloth Co. is due 21 December. I credited it to him, with the #north-team message it came from.

I couldn't check the date against anything else. The brain has nothing on Thornbury, though its search is keyword-only, and I can't see any Thornbury files in the shared folders. So it's saved exactly as he gave it.

I replied to Marcus in a thread on his message to say it's noted. As he asked, I took no other action.
